pdf_page_count fails when the supplied password does not authenticate the document

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        try {
        var result = Xberg.pdfPageCount(java.nio.file.Files.readAllBytes(java.nio.file.Path.of("pdf/password_protected.pdf")), "xberg-test-fake-wrong-password-1879");
        System.out.println(result);
        } catch (XbergRsException error) {
            System.err.println(error.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + error.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```
